chapter: New Orleans ballrooms and Tony Almerico
title: Tony Almerico's nicknames and his square, hard-working character
summary: They discuss the Porkchop nickname, and Jones describes Almerico as a teetotaling square who was the butt of practical jokes like BBs on the bandstand.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: We've got another ten minutes or so. Okay. Yeah, yeah.
What the hell, I've only got to go to work.
Yeah, well I mean, they don't care. Today's payday, so. Okay, well you get there early. Well, you never heard anybody called Tony pokechop?
A lot of people did that?

A lot of people did. Roy Zimmerman used to call him pokechops. That was plural, pokechops. Pokechops. Pokechops. As I remember, pokechops. Or pokechops. Maybe it was pokechops. I don't know. Sam Decker Mill called me pokechops.
Hmm. And I've never known why either. It's something I never thought about.

Yeah, I never thought about it either. That was one of his nicknames. He was a, he was just a, I don't know, he was, I don't mean this with any disrespect, but Tony Almerico was what would have been termed, I guess, a square. You know, he was very innocent, very trusting. He didn't, he smoked that cigar. I don't think he probably, in his entire life, never consumed a fifth of alcohol. He wasn't a drinker. And he was a hard worker, and a just getting out and flat hustling kind of guy. And he never expected anybody to ever do it, man. I mean he expected, you know, everybody was the best of everything, and you would, I guess, just have to consider him a square. And I know they used to like to kid him, and they used to play practical jokes on him. He had a thing about having something underfoot. If he was standing up and maybe a matchstick or something was under his shoe, you could tell it, and it made him feel uncomfortable. Yeah. And I can remember Pete telling, he would go on a job and then bring a handful of BBs, and spread it on the bandstands, and keep Porkchop in a state of flat unrest all the time. But I mean they used to play practical jokes on him.
